appropriate: a heavy U-cradle holding a solid rounded square reads as 'a thing held, nothing dropped' with a sentence; calm, upright and enclosing suits Sage with Caregiver
distinctive: free of hexagons, links and loops, but the thick open arc sits near Convoy's thick broken-ring C, and a U-with-block is a generic lettermark silhouette
simple: one thick U arc plus one rounded square; drawable from memory in two strokes
legible: the square stays separate from the arc down to 24 px and is still a dot-in-cup at 16 px, though the gap is tight; 'Orvane' reads cleanly in every lockup
adaptable: holds in black, reversed white-on-black, one colour at 64 and 32, the amber app tile, the browser tab and the dark header bar
timeless: plain geometric arc and square, no gradient or trend shape; the soft rounded-square block is the only touch of current app-icon styling
universal: mirrored is identical, but rotated 90 reads as a C or E clasping a block, and upright the mark can read as the letter U, which is not the name's initial, or as a cup or smiling face
clear: unsearched: U-cup lettermarks with a dot or block inside are common across app icons and SaaS marks, and the rotated form recalls Convoy's thick C; nothing identical comes to mind
congruent: warm amber on warm near-black, symmetric, static, medium-heavy weight, round outside and square inside, all on target; the wordmark is a plain geometric sans in title case with no owned detail
system: the horizontal lockup, reversed, tier ladder from 256 to 16 and mockups all derive cleanly; no stacked lockup is shown, and the wordmark has no detail that ties it to the symbol
